items.source:
The type name may match the fully-qualified class name of
the annotation or the short class name (without the package).
items.translation: 类型名称可能与注解的完全限定类名或短类名（不含包）匹配。

items.source: typeName - the name of the annotation type
Construct a qualifier to match against an annotation of the given type whose value attribute also matches the specified value.
items.translation: 构建一个限定符以匹配给定类型的注解，且该注解的 `<code>value` 属性也匹配指定的值。

items.source:
Qualifier for resolving autowire candidates. A bean definition that
includes one or more such qualifiers enables fine-grained matching
against annotations on a field or parameter to be autowired.
items.translation: 用于解析自动装配候选者的限定符。包含一个或多个此类限定符的 Bean 定义，能够实现对字段或参数上的注解进行细粒度匹配，以完成自动装配。

items.source: The name of the key used to store the value.
items.translation: 用于存储值的键的名称。

items.source:
Retrieve the type name. This value will be the same as the
type name provided to the constructor or the fully-qualified
class name if a Class instance was provided to the constructor.
items.translation: 检索类型名称。此值将与提供给构造器的类型名称相同，或者如果向构造器提供了 Class 实例，则为完全限定类名。
